title: Show HN: Tiny-vLLM – high performance LLM inference engine in C++ and CUDA
summary: Tiny-vLLM is a lightweight, high-performance LLM inference engine implemented in C++ and CUDA, designed as a simplified alternative to the popular vLLM project. The project aims to provide efficient large language model serving capabilities with optimized GPU acceleration, targeting developers who need a more portable or minimal footprint inference solution.
problem_solved: Provides a lightweight, high-performance alternative for running LLM inference with GPU acceleration without the full complexity of vLLM.
why_valuable: Offers a more portable and minimal C++/CUDA-based inference engine that can potentially run with lower resource overhead while maintaining high throughput for large language models.
